definition: An act that shows serious disrespect for something sacred.
author: Mary Shelley
quote: It appeared to me sacrilege so soon to leave the repose, akin to death, of the house of mourning and to rush into the thick of life.
example_sentence: Putting pineapple on a pizza is sacrilege to some Italians.
